svg.title: Earthquakes of Turkey (Earthquake-Database-For-Turkey)
svg.desc: Earthquakes of Turkey, repository Earthquake-Database-For-Turkey. A friendlier way to browse Turkey's earthquakes: sort by any column, filter by your city. A hobby project. Python.
svg.text: A friendlier way to browse Turkey's earthquakes: sort by any column, filter by your city. A hobby project.
